findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:30 reports 762 Chinese-bearing cli-engine.ts lines, but docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:167 defines the current table as a catalog and defers every-line coverage to a later manifest; docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md:90 and :373 also state that every Chinese-bearing line still needs manifest mapping. The committed document contains 173 T### catalog rows, so it is a representative catalog plus an execution plan, not the complete every-Chinese-translation result set requested for human audit. This blocks the requested deliverable until the document includes an auditable line-level translation result/mapping for all 762 Chinese-bearing lines or clearly obtains user acceptance for a representative catalog instead.
